name: RWP Chat & AI Assistant
author: React-WP
description: A floating and inline chat widget with a Gemini-backed assistant, a pre-chat lead form, file attachments, product and order context on shop pages, and handover to a live agent by Telegram or WhatsApp.

retains: Attachments visitors sent stay in the Media Library's chat_media folder, and at Cloudinary. Delete that folder from the Media Library to remove them.
rwp_chat_card_product and rwp_chat_order_status belong to rwp-shop and are dropped by its own uninstall.
